title: SynDrone end-to-end results (Phases 7 to 10)
description: x-files maps each file's path inside this folder to its definition (first match applies); tests/test_results_schema.py checks every file against it. Written by scripts/results_schema.py from the existing files: required keys are those every file has; shares and probabilities lie in 0 to 1; counts, sizes and times are not negative. Each definition's description names the script that writes the file.

eval.description: scripts/syndrone_evaluate.py: detection, tracking, range and speed per group, pooled with 95 % intervals resampling sequences and towns, by height and per sequence

search.description: scripts/syndrone_search_metrics.py: ground searched, false alarms per km2 and share of people found (D-749)

breakdowns.description: scripts/syndrone_breakdowns.py: range and speed error by camera angle, true range, object size, height and class

compare.description: scripts/syndrone_compare.py: one run against another on the same sequences

speed_display_fit.description: scripts/syndrone_speed_display_fit.py: when a speed is shown (D-710, D-739)

interval_calibration.description: scripts/syndrone_interval_calibration.py: range and speed interval calibration (D-737)
